title: Create deterministic prompt layer ordering module chatbot/core/prompt_layers.py
description:
Create the prompt layers module `chatbot/core/prompt_layers.py`.

This module must define a deterministic composition and prioritization of system prompt layers. The composing pipeline should stack prompt blocks in the following order (from general safety to dynamic turn-level details):
1. Safety Floor
2. Platform Behavior
3. Companion Identity
4. Relationship Stage
5. Room/Scene
6. Mood/State
7. Memory
8. Session Goals

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- chatbot/core/ (if any existing modules) for import conventions and prompt handling

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/core/prompt_layers.py exists and is a valid Python module
Prompt composition compiles system prompts in safety -> session goals priority order
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: define helper dataclasses or Pydantic models for prompt blocks
add unit tests specifically for prompt_layers module if needed
forbidden: modify turn execution flow outside prompt_layers.py
